DVMP Quick Guide

This page briefly introduces DVMP_xsec module for deeply virtual meson production (DVMP) observables.

The module provides:

  • the ratio \(R = \sigma_L/\sigma_T\) for exclusive meson production,

  • fitted \(R\) parameters from combined H1+ZEUS \(\rho^0\) data,

  • longitudinal and total differential cross-sections \(d\sigma_L/dt\) and \(d\sigma/dt\).

DVMP Main Callables

  • DVMP_xsec.R(): parametrization of \(R(Q)\).

  • DVMP_xsec.R_rho_fit(): iMinuit fit of \((a, p)\) in DVMP_xsec.R().

  • DVMP_xsec.R_fitted(): fitted \(R(Q)\) with propagated uncertainty.

  • DVMP_xsec.epsilon(): virtual-photon polarization parameter \(\varepsilon\).

  • DVMP_xsec.dsigmaL_DVMP_dt(): longitudinal cross-section \(d\sigma_L/dt\).

  • DVMP_xsec.dsigma_DVMP_dt(): total cross-section \(d\sigma/dt = (d\sigma_L/dt)\,(\varepsilon + 1/R)\).

Meson Code Convention

The meson argument follows the same integer convention across the module:

  • 1: \(\rho^0\)

  • 2: \(\phi\)

  • 3: \(J/\psi\)

In DVMP_xsec.MassCorr(), the heavy-meson correction uses \(M_{J/\psi}\) for meson=3 and 0 otherwise.

DVMP Common Inputs

The DVMP cross-section functions use:

  • y (float): inelasticity (beam energy-loss fraction).

  • xB (float): Bjorken \(x_B\).

  • t (float): momentum transfer squared (GeV^2).

  • Q (float): photon virtuality (GeV).

  • HTFF (complex): helicity-conserving TFF \(\mathcal{H}\).

  • ETFF (complex): helicity-flip TFF \(\mathcal{E}\).

For DVMP_xsec.dsigma_DVMP_dt(), two additional fit parameters are used:

  • a (float): fit parameter \(a\) entering DVMP_xsec.R().

  • p (float): fit parameter \(p\) entering DVMP_xsec.R().

References

  • DVMP_xsec.R() and DVMP_xsec.epsilon() follow arXiv:1112.2597.

  • DVMP_xsec.dsigmaL_DVMP_dt() and DVMP_xsec.dsigma_DVMP_dt() follow arXiv:2409.17231.
